reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed. Gate 1: try_stop_borrow_deleverage (private wrapper, market.move:685) is actively called at market.move:789 from liquidation_inner — not dead code. Gate 2: no trust_assumptions in scope file; the liquidation entry point is public and externally callable by any user. Gate 3: market.move is explicitly in scope and liquidation logic is a listed focus area. The floor()/ceil() inconsistency is verified in code: the collateral path (market.move:680) and repay path (market.move:491) both use .ceil(), while the liquidation borrow path (market.move:686) uses .floor(), allowing premature ADL deactivation when actual borrow is in the open interval (target_amount, target_amount+1). Attack path is real but requires landing precisely in a 1-base-unit fractional window, making intentional exploitation uncertain — CONFIRMED_POTENTIAL rather than CONFIRMED_VULNERABILITY. Severity capped at Medium: the safety mechanism deviation is real but the maximum misalignment is 1 base unit.
